player_prompt.intro:
I ye Jokelani {player_id} SimpleTak. 
Bɔn, o sunjata ye '{player_stone}' aurɛ o tɛmɛw sunjata ye '{opponent_stone}'.

Anw wele, i ka celule gɛlɛn (kɔfɛ a lajɛ) aurɛ i ka o sunjata ko. 
Sisan, '[12]' ka o sunjata ko celule 12.

O bɛnna ye ko o sunjata kɔnɔntɔn naani bɔ bɛɛnna (kɔkɔla-bɛɛn aurɛ kɔrɔn-kɔrɔn) bɛɛ o bɔ.

invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Soli {cell_num} bɛ yen ka ban. Sɛli dɔ sugandi min tɛ yan.

action.placement: Jokelani {current_player_id} da danbe so sunjata ({symbol}) ko celule {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
